title: 实现 A/B 测试 compare endpoint
description: R-M26-005 核心交付。新增 /reader/compare endpoint，接受 A/B 文本 + personas，分别用 DualEngine.analyze 分析两个版本，再用 ConsensusEngine 做差异共识，返回对比报告。
action: 在 reader-endpoints.ts 新增 rsCompareEndpoint 处理 POST /reader/compare。请求体 { novelId, versionA: { text, label? }, versionB: { text, label? }, personaIds? }。分别调用 DualEngine.analyze 分析 A/B，使用 ConsensusEngine.buildConsensus 分别构建共识，然后计算差异共识（新增对比维度）。

criteria: reader-endpoints.ts 中新增 rsCompareEndpoint 函数，处理 POST /reader/compare
返回结果包含 versionAConsensus, versionBConsensus, comparison（差异项列表）三个字段
comparison 中每个差异项包含 dimension, versionAScore, versionBScore, delta, winner: 'A'|'B'|'tie'
convergence.verification: grep 确认 rsCompareEndpoint 存在；grep 确认返回结构含 versionAConsensus, versionBConsensus, comparison；运行新增测试
convergence.definition_of_done: /reader/compare 可接受 A/B 文本和 personas，返回结构化对比报告

files.change: 新增 rsCompareEndpoint 处理 POST /reader/compare
新增 compareConsensus 方法，计算两个 ConsensusReport 的差异

implementation: 定义 CompareRequest 接口：{ novelId: string; versionA: { text: string; label?: string }; versionB: { text: string; label?: string }; personaIds?: string[] }
定义 CompareResult 接口：{ versionAConsensus: ConsensusReport; versionBConsensus: ConsensusReport; comparison: ConsensusComparisonItem[]; overallWinner: 'A'|'B'|'tie' }
定义 ConsensusComparisonItem：{ dimension: string; versionAScore: number; versionBScore: number; delta: number; winner: 'A'|'B'|'tie'; notes: string }
在 ConsensusEngine 新增 compareConsensus(reportA, reportB): ConsensusComparisonItem[] 方法
compareConsensus 逐维度对比 avgScore，计算 delta，标记 winner
在 reader-endpoints.ts 实现 rsCompareEndpoint：解析请求 -> resolvePersonas -> analyze A -> analyze B -> buildConsensus A -> buildConsensus B -> compareConsensus -> 返回

rationale.chosen_approach: 复用现有 engine，新增对比层
decision_factors: 复用已验证的 consensus 逻辑

risks.title: 对比维度与前端期望不匹配
risks.mitigation: 与 TASK-002 统一的数据契约保持一致
